newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline basis seen firming.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline basis seen firming.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline basis was seen firming on dwindling supplies in the region as the markets shifted focus to May deliveries, traders said on Wednesday.

Midwest PADD 2 refiners reported an estimated 1.48 million barrel draw in gasoline on hand for the week ended April 25, leaving stocks 4.6 million barrels below the same week last year, the American Petroleum Institute said late Tuesday.
"With the drawdown, obviously it's going to be very positive for basis into May," one Group trader said.
The Williams pipeline system, a key barometer of Group Three stocks, reported a relatively thin 17-day supply of gasoline, traders said.
Earlier in the day, some players were caught short on late-April gasoline barrels, pushing basis sharply higher as the market wound down trade for the month.
Traders said talk through the end of the week would be muted by Tenneco's annual outing in Houston and a Group Three outing set for Thursday and Friday.
Group Three unleaded for May deliveries was bid 0.50 cent a gallon over June NYMEX unleaded, with Chicago bid even with the print.
Group Three low sulphur diesel for May deliveries was bid 6.75 cents a gallon over June NYMEX heating oil, with Chicago bid 2.50 cents over.
Group Three high sulphur diesel was talked 6.50/6.75 cents a gallon over the print, with Chicago 1.50 cents over for May deliveries.
